title: Cancel asynchronous text output explicitly
goal: Pass operation cancellation to text and newline writes, retaining the valid older memory route and accounting for partial output from the concrete writer.

prerequisites: SDK console/library project with Nullable and ImplicitUsings enabled; include each complete canonical helper as a separate .cs file.
constraints: Use a cancellation-aware concrete writer; arbitrary TextWriter subclasses can ignore tokens. Serial await before flush/disposal; cancellation does not roll back bytes and later cleanup can flush buffers.
